name: The Piano Staircase to Nowhere
description: A grand piano made of white marble transforms into a sweeping staircase that ascends into misty clouds, each step playing a different musical note as someone walks upward.
prompt: An enormous grand piano constructed from pure white marble with intricate gold inlays, the instrument gradually transforming into a sweeping marble staircase that ascends into billowing white clouds, each step embedded with musical keys that light up and play soft notes, ethereal mist surrounding the base, heavenly lighting from above, highly detailed fantasy architecture, magical realism style
caption: Every step plays a new melody on the staircase to dreams... 🎹☁️ What song carries you upward?
